acceptanceCriteria.text: Opening the GitHub Pages site root exposes links to published PR review pages.
`/reviews/pr/<PR>/` provides a stable human-facing route to the latest immutable revision for that PR.
Publishing a new revision updates only the mutable navigation projection while preserving all immutable revision directories.
Publishing multiple PRs preserves all root-index entries.
Tests cover stable PR navigation, root navigation, and update-to-latest behavior.
Existing immutable revision conflict handling and publication retry semantics remain unchanged.

issue.title: feat: add stable navigation paths for Review Pages
